//: SvelteKit writes the real compiler options into .svelte-kit/tsconfig.json when it syncs the project. Extending them keeps this file from restating aliases the framework already knows. {{to_root}} is the layout's own answer to how far this file sits from the workspace root, so this reaches .svelte-kit/tsconfig.json whether or not the selection namespaced app_dir. TypeScript does not merge `paths` across `extends`, so this file's own `paths` fully replaces the generated one and has to restate $lib alongside the alias it adds. The generated config's own `include` is written relative to .svelte-kit and reaches the whole workspace's src and test trees, not just this layer's, so a second frontend's files would be dragged into this layer's type check; `include` below fully replaces it the same way `paths` does, scoped to this layer's own app_dir and test_dir plus the ambient files SvelteKit generates.
